purpose: Split the prospectively validated program's MLP15+17 mediation into exact MLP15-only, MLP17-only, and joint clamp effects, without fitting or changing the ten-vector program.

prior_art_search.result: The natural head-donor intervention has an existing exact MLP15-by-MLP17 additive-pair screen, and the fixed program has a grouped MLP15+17 mediation screen. No result splits MLP15 from MLP17 for the fixed direction-cardinality program.

intervention.cells: all 512 prospective third-corpus row x E/A/U/W-subset cells
intervention.corners: base/program crossed with clamp set empty, {15}, {17}, {15,17}

predictions.pred_a_complete_exact_factorial: All immutable inputs validate; exactly 512 cells and eight corners per cell are present; no-clamp effect, base replay, and grouped both-clamp effect replay the immutable grouped result to <=5e-5.
predictions.pred_b_additive_distributed_pair: Each singleton mediation norm is >=5% of the full program-effect norm, interaction norm is <=25% of joint-mediation norm, and m15+m17 predicts joint mediation with cosine >=0.90 and relative L2 error <=0.25.
predictions.pred_c_single_dominant_mediator: Opposing outcome: one singleton is >=80% of joint-mediation norm and the other is <=10%, with dominant-to-joint cosine >=0.90.
predictions.pred_d_distribution_recurs_across_cells: Both singleton norm ratios are >=3% of full effect in at least three of four direction x template groups and at least four of five cardinalities; joint interaction remains <=35% in every direction x template group.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_program_and_price: No vectors, scales, rows, subsets, sites, or thresholds change after outcomes; price <=17 physical forwards, 4192 example evaluations, zero backwards, zero updates.

terminal_rule: Invalid if a or e fails; additive_distributed_screen if b and d pass; single_dominant_screen if c passes; otherwise inconclusive.
